scope: Primary documentation and metadata; not instructions to run ingestion or approve publication.

BLS_CPI_SA.finding: SA CPI can be revised for five years; choose SA/NSA for the question.

BLS_CES.finding: Establishment jobs and earnings concepts, monthly revisions and employment benchmarking.

BLS_CPS.finding: Household survey concepts, population controls and redesign documentation.

BLS_JOLTS.finding: Job-opening stocks, hires and separation flows are distinct.

BLS_RIGHTS.finding: Original BLS material is public domain, with stated exceptions; cite BLS.

BEA_NIPA.finding: Chain-type prices/real output, annual-rate conventions and nonadditive chained-dollar components.

BEA_REVISIONS.finding: Current, annual and benchmark updates revise different spans and inputs.

BEA_RIGHTS.finding: Original BEA information is public domain unless stated otherwise; attribution requested.

H15.finding: Monthly figures include calendar days; effective-rate method changed on 2016-03-01. Fitted yields are not bond returns.

BOARD_RIGHTS.finding: Original Board information may be copied/distributed with attribution, excluding third-party material.

NY_EFFR.finding: FR 2420 transaction-based volume-weighted median, publication/revision flags and separate target range.

FOMC.finding: Official statement/implementation-note links; scheduled and unscheduled decisions must both be represented.

FOMC_ARCHIVE.finding: Historical target decisions; pre-1994 announcement conventions differ.

PRE1994.finding: Historical intended target chronology is not uniformly equivalent to a timestamped modern announcement.

DFEDTAR.finding: Metadata range 1982-09-27 through 2008-12-15; discontinued point target.

DFEDTARL.finding: Target lower bound is effective-day state, not the announcement timestamp.

DFEDTARU.finding: Separate target upper bound; preserve range width and both endpoints.

DFII10.finding: Ten-year inflation-indexed constant-maturity yield; first listed date 2003-01-02.

FED_TIPS.finding: Model-based curves are staff research products, subject to revision/method change, not the H.15 constant-maturity release.

GSW_TIPS.finding: A separate fitted daily TIPS curve begins in 1999; it cannot silently extend DFII10.

T5YIE.finding: St. Louis Fed-derived nominal-minus-TIPS spread; includes liquidity/risk premia. Citation-required tag.

T10Y2Y.finding: St. Louis Fed-derived nominal yield difference, not a recession forecast or total return.

FED_DOLLAR.finding: Broad trade-weighted basket/weights differ from ICE's fixed six-currency index.

FED_DOLLAR_CHANGE.finding: Goods/services trade-weight changes and a 2006 back-history for the revised broad measure; no blind splice with old indexes.

IBA_GOLD.finding: Licensed London spot benchmark auctions at 10:30 and 15:00 London time; prices are unallocated loco London.

LBMA_HISTORY.finding: London benchmark history and change to IBA administration on 2015-03-20.

GOLD_FRED_REMOVAL.finding: IBA gold data removed from FRED services on 2022-01-31; old identifiers are not a usable current API source.

WGC_GOLD.finding: Historical LBMA data removal noted from 2025-03-18; monthly/quarterly/annual averages are not daily event prices.

CME_SETTLEMENT.finding: Gold active-month settlement window 13:29-13:30 ET under the documented 2010 change; verify the applicable rule/version for each historical event.

CME_SETTLEMENT_CURRENT.finding: Current exchange documentation lists gold's normal 13:29-13:30 ET settlement window; exceptions/historical methods require checks.

CME_RIGHTS.finding: Historical charts/downloads have licensing conditions. Verify actual product, vendor and onward rights; a public quote is not a grant.

SP500.finding: Original index owner, price/total-return variants and live/back-tested history distinctions.

ICE_DXY.finding: Fixed six-currency geometry, euro 57.6%, March 1973 base and euro transition; this is not the Fed broad basket.

YAHOO_RIGHTS.finding: Automated legal-page retrieval returned 999. No MacroLens-specific onward-distribution grant was found. Review vendor and underlying-owner rights independently.
YAHOO_RIGHTS.validation: unverified legal text; ticker metadata checks succeeded

DOL_CLAIMS.finding: Insured weekly claims, week-ending references, revisions and seasonal caveats.

DOL_RIGHTS.finding: Government-origin DOL information generally public domain; third-party exceptions remain.

GOV_RIGHTS.finding: US federal-government works are not protected by US copyright; verify producer ownership rather than treating every hosted dataset as government-origin.

CENSUS_RETAIL.finding: Nominal retail sales, seasonal/trading-day adjustment, fuller estimates and benchmark revisions.

CENSUS_NRC.finding: Authorizations, starts and completions, SAAR rates and sampling/revision conventions.

PCEC96_RANGE.finding: Current metadata/table starts in 2007, rather than proving a complete 1959 history.

G17.finding: Annual changes include benchmarks, monthly inputs, seasonal factors, methods and industry structures.

PMMS.finding: Weekly PMMS and 2022-11-17 application-based method change; Freddie Mac copyright/attribution.

PMMS_RIGHTS.finding: Limited automatic-data website syndication permission exists for PMMS; its conditions and API/export/storage scope require review, not a blanket open-data assumption.

MICHIGAN.finding: One-month FRED lag, source copyright/citation and early-history caveats.

MICHIGAN_METHOD.finding: April-July 2024 interview-mode transition can affect changes; source advises conservative interpretation.

ICE_HY.finding: Current rolling three-year window from April 2026; third-party pre-approval-required tag and index restrictions.

ICE_IG.finding: Corporate OAS definition and limited current history; underlying ICE rights apply.

EIA_WTI.finding: EIA Cushing WTI spot comparison identifier; listed history starts 1986-01-02. Verify direct EIA route/selector before integration.

EIA_RIGHTS.finding: EIA permits use/distribution of its original data; third-party exceptions remain.

FRED_TERMS.finding: Source copyright and service permission are separate. Current API sections III(k)-(m) restrict AI-related use, caching/archiving and onward stored-data delivery; the application's CSV route also needs service-scope clarification. Prefer cleared first-party routes for original government data. No permission flags were changed.

L_BLS.conditions: Original BLS statistics; cite BLS. Transport T_FRED is separate.

L_BEA.conditions: Original BEA statistics unless an exception is stated; cite BEA. Transport T_FRED is separate.

L_BOARD.conditions: Original Board statistics, with attribution and third-party exceptions. Transport T_FRED is separate.

L_DOL.conditions: Government-produced ETA statistics, attribution and third-party exceptions. Transport T_FRED is separate.

L_GOV.conditions: Original Census/HUD federal statistics; cite the producing agency; do not extend this conclusion to third-party hosted material.

L_STL.conditions: Bank-created derived series, not automatically federal public-domain works. Review current distribution route and permitted product use.

L_PMMS.conditions: A limited PMMS website permission exists; confirm its conditions and separate cached API/export/AI use before declaring the whole MacroLens flow cleared.

L_MICH.conditions: Follow the source's copyright citation; confirm public API/archive and any model use independently.

L_ICE.conditions: Document underlying-owner approval for the actual display, download/API, historical storage and derived uses; no grant was located in the repository.

L_MARKET.conditions: No auditable Yahoo/underlying CME, ICE or S&P onward grant in repository. Retrieve legal terms manually if needed; metadata access is not permission.

T_FRED.action: Clarify actual CSV/export service scope or use authorized producer-native routes. Do not relabel a producer-direct replacement behind an existing ID without reviewed equivalence and provenance.

T_YAHOO.action: Clear both vendor and underlying-owner permissions for the actual product; no source substitution or production disablement in this audit.
